safi-cedvel:1-4.t:
* I'rab:
(والسماء) is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear" (أقسم). (الواو) the third is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) in both places. (النجم) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "it is" (هو). (إن) is a negative particle. (لمّا) is a particle of restriction meaning إلّا. (عليها) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (حافظ).
Clause: « (أقسم) بالسماء ... » has no grammatical position (inceptive).
And the clause: «ما أدراك ... » has no grammatical position (parenthetical).
And the clause: «أدراك ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ (ما).
And the clause: «ما الطارق ... » is in the position of accusative as the second direct object (mafʿūl bihi) of the verb أدراك.
And the clause: « (هو) النجم» has no grammatical position (explanatory resumptive).
And the clause: «إنّ كلّ نفس لمّا ... » has no grammatical position (answer to the oath).
And the clause: «عليها حافظ» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كلّ).

* Morphology:
(الطارق) originally an active participle from the triliteral طرق, meaning "to travel at night"; its wazn is فاعل. It was then applied as a generic noun or for a known star.

* Benefits:
- (لمّا) as a particle of exception:
Among the uses of (لمّا) is that it comes as a particle of exception, entering a nominal sentence, as in this verse (إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْها حافِظٌ). It also enters a past-tense verb in form but not in meaning, for example:
«أنشدك الله لمّا فعلت» that is, "I ask you by Allah nothing but that you do it".

safi-cedvel:5-7.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive. (اللام) is the lām of command. (ممّ) is attached to (خلق); (ما) is interrogative, and its alif is dropped because a preposition precedes it. (من ماء) is attached to the second (خلق). (من بين) is attached to (يخرج).
Clause: «لينظر الإنسان» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «خلق (الأولى) » is in the position of accusative as the direct object of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, by implying a preposition.
And the clause: «خلق (الثانية) » has no grammatical position (explanatory resumptive).
And the clause: «يخرج ... » is in the position of genitive as an naʿt (adjective) of ماء «[Note: or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ماء, because it has been specified by the qualification.]».

* Morphology:
(6) دافق: an active participle from the triliteral دفق; its wazn is فاعل «[Note: in the verse it is a majāz ʿaqlī (rational figurative usage) meaning "poured" (مدفوق), or it is used in the sense of attribution, i.e. "possessing outpouring".]».
(7) الصلب: a noun meaning the back; its wazn is فعل (with ḍamma and sukūn); its plural is أصلاب, on the wazn أفعال.
(الترائب) plural of تريبة, a noun for the chest, or its ribs, or its flesh and blood; its wazn is فعيلة like صحيفة, and the plural is فعائل. It contains the change of yāʾ into hamza because it comes after a silent alif; the original is ترايب.

* Rhetoric:
Ṭibāq (antithesis): in His words, the Exalted, «مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرائِبِ».
He set the bone of the back against the bone of the chest, putting the first in the singular and the latter in the plural, because a woman's chest is her تريبة, so one says of a woman "ترائب", meaning the تريبة and what is around it and surrounds it.
Or it is said that the Exalted meant: "He brings forth from between the backbones and the chests," and was content with the singular in place of the plural, as the Exalted said «أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كانَتا رَتْقاً فَفَتَقْناهُما» without saying "the earths".

safi-cedvel:8-10.t:
* I'rab:
(على رجعه) is attached to (قادر); the pronoun in it refers to the gushing fluid or to the human being. (يوم) is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (رجعه) «[Note: This applies if the pronoun in (رجعه) is taken to refer to the human being; if it is taken to refer to the fluid, the adverbial is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He returns him" (i.e. the human being), or its implied form being "remember".]». (الفاء) links the apodosis of an implied condition. (له) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (قوّة), which is genitive in form, nominative in position. (الواو) is a conjunction. (لا) is redundant (zāʾida) to reinforce the negation. (ناصر) is conjoined to قوّة, genitive in form like it.
Clause: «إنّه ... لقادر» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «تبلى السرائر ... » is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «ما له من قوّة ... » has no grammatical position (apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "when he is raised on the Day of Resurrection, he has no ...").

* Morphology:
(9) السرائر: plural of سريرة, on the wazn فعيلة, meaning what is concealed in the soul; the plural فعائل contains the change of yāʾ into hamza because it comes after a silent alif; its original form is given as السرائر «[Translator's note: the source gives the original form identical to the plural itself; presumably السراير is intended]».

safi-cedvel:11-14.t:
* I'rab:
(والسماء) is like the preceding one «[Note: in verse (1) of the sūra]». (ذات) is an naʿt (adjective) of السماء, genitive. (الأرض) is conjoined to السماء by the wāw, genitive. (اللام) is the lām of the oath, a substitute for the shifted lām. (الواو) is a conjunction. (ما) is a negative particle acting like ليس. (الهزل) is genitive in form, accusative in position, as the khabar of ما.
Clause: « (أقسم) بالسماء» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «إنّه لقول ... » has no grammatical position (answer to the oath).
And the clause: «ما هو بالهزل» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause that answers the oath).

* Morphology:
(الصدع) is a samāʿī (heard-form) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral صدع, meaning "to split", or a name for a crack in the earth from which plants come out; its wazn is فعل (with fatḥa and sukūn).
(الهزل) is a samāʿī maṣdar of the triliteral هزل, meaning "to be not serious"; its wazn is فعل (with fatḥa and sukūn).

safi-cedvel:15-17.t:
* I'rab:
(كيدا) is an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq), accusative «[Note: this is according to the apparent sense; it may be a direct object, i.e. they devise plots against the Prophet, peace be upon him, and the second (كيدا) means "I repel the plot"]», in both places. (الفاء) links the apodosis of an implied condition. (رويدا) is an absolute object standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its synonym.
Clause: «إنهم يكيدون ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «يكيدون ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
And the clause: «أكيد ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) «[Note: or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive]».
And the clause: «مهّل ... » is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if they plot against you, then give them respite".
And the clause: «أمهلهم رويدا» has no grammatical position (resumptive, emphasising the preceding clause).

* Morphology:
(رويدا) is said to be a diminutive of tarkhīm by dropping the augments; its full form is إرواد (with kasra on the hamza), and its wazn is فعيل (with ḍamma on the first letter and fatḥa on the second). Or it is the diminutive of رود (with ḍamma on the rāʾ, on the pattern of عود), i.e. "respite". In al-Mukhtār it says: you say رويدك عمرا, i.e. "give him respite"; it is a tarkhīm diminutive of إرواد, the maṣdar of أرود يرود (with kasra on the wāw).
And رويدا is used as a maṣdar in place of the verb's utterance, so one says رويد زيد or رويدا زيدا, i.e. "give him respite"; it occurs as a ḥāl, as in ساروا رويدا, i.e. "they travelled slowly"; and it occurs as an absolute object standing in for the maṣdar by being an adjective of it, i.e. ساروا سيرا رويدا.

* Benefits:
- (بله) and (رويد).
(بله) is a maṣdar whose verb fell out of use, and (رويد) is a tarkhīm maṣdar of the verb (أرود, meaning "give respite"). When they occur without tanwīn they are verbal nouns of command (ism fiʿl amr), for example: (بله العاجز) "leave the incapable one" and (رويد لمفلس) "give the bankrupt respite". But when they take tanwīn: (بلها أخاك) and (رويدا المفلس), they are accusative maṣdars as absolute objects of their omitted verbs, not verbal nouns. Likewise if what follows them is put in the genitive by annexation to it (بله أخيك) (رويد المفلس); here too they are absolute objects.
